Go through this repo, and the current branch. I want you to help research and find the best way to design a memory-extraction pipeline for this problem statement.

The design should:
1. Be true to what all the conversations capture
2. Should capture all the various dimensions of the person
   - Personal, Work, Friendship, Hobbies, etc.
   - Should have temporal information so we know recent info from old ones
   - should allow navigation based on these areas
3. It should act as a second brain, where someone can navigate the information and move it around

The extraction process should be generic and update incrementally as more conversations arrive, recategorizing past information when new information suggests it. The broad themes should emerge.

The user should be allowed to correct any information at any time.

I've seen tools that use folder structures (as categories/themes) with small markdown files as extracted memories, linking back to actual conversations. Please research and push back if that isn't the right data structure, or if there's a better way to do any of this.

Basically I want an indexed, queryable structure that captures all the conversations I've had, exposed via MCP, with scoping by category (work only, relationships only, finance only, etc.).
